rows.art_direction_premise: THE SURVEYED COURTYARD — overhead architectural photograph annotated like a survey
rows.environmental_strategy: Environment is the data object (courtyard proportions encode the breakdown)
rows.material_strategy: Travertine floor, limewashed walls, limestone courses, bronze inlay, brass plates, oak door
rows.object_language: Architecture: walls, courses, door, floor inlay
rows.typographic_strategy: Figure cast and inlaid in bronze in the floor; engraved plate labels
rows.brand_lockup_strategy: Carved cornerstone plaque + tagline engraved on the wall face
rows.data_encoding: Area ratio (floor ÷ room) and wall-course length
rows.cta_expression: Emerald tile on the axis directly below the closed oak door — the door leads to the breakdown

rows.art_direction_premise: THE ANSWER IN RAKING LIGHT — one carved sentence on a sunlit limestone wall
rows.environmental_strategy: Environment frames and lights the answer (window at the edge supplies clarity)
rows.material_strategy: Honed limestone, carving, emerald enamel, brass inlay, oak window
rows.object_language: Inscription: carved letters, inlaid metal words, hanging tag, maker’s plate
rows.typographic_strategy: Monumental carved serif sentence; metal vs stone distinguishes openable words
rows.visual_wit: Only the words that hold money are made of metal
rows.data_encoding: Inline words + one half-filled brass rule (filled = clear, empty groove = held)
rows.cta_expression: Full-width emerald slab closing the column, under generous stone

rows.art_direction_premise: THE SORTING RACK — entry-hall still life where money is sorted like post
rows.environmental_strategy: Environment is the organising system (rack, console, letter in layers)
rows.material_strategy: Oak, brass, cotton paper, linen envelopes, burgundy wax, travertine console, plaster wall
rows.object_language: Stationery and furniture: rack, sealed envelopes, released letter, broken seal
rows.typographic_strategy: Letterhead stationery layout with letterpress figure; engraved slot plates
rows.depth_model: Three-quarter frontal still life with real depth
rows.brand_lockup_strategy: Letterhead lockup + botanical emboss on every wax seal
rows.visual_wit: The broken seal — the only letter you have opened
rows.data_encoding: Envelope thickness ∝ amount; open vs sealed
rows.cta_expression: Emerald tile under the console, after the objects
